This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with a prayer for direction to the opp. parties to take necessary action regarding consideration of the representation under Annexure-6 and re-estimate the quantum of the compensation amount as per the Govt. bench Mark Valuation and nearest vicinity area.

When the matter was taken up on 11.02.2025, learned counsel for the petitioners prayed for an adjournment to obtain necessary instruction as to whether any steps have been taken by the petitioners in terms of section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Signed by: RAJESH KUMAR BADHEI
Designation: Junior Stenographer Reason: Authentication Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter 2013 Act).

On instruction, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that such application has not been filed and seeks permission to withdraw this writ petition in order to file an application under section 64 of the 2013 Act.
In view of such submissions, the writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge (Savitri Ratho) Judge Rajesh Laksmikanta Mahanta vs State Of Odisha & on 5 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196817875/
